limitations: Synthetic tiny silent test patterns are technical probe/preparation throughput only; no representative video, semantic/frame quality or real provider cost acceptance.
6 files request full native preparation; other eligible files use probeOnly; no full200-video scan/AI pipeline is claimed.
Drained child-process restart reuses metadata checkpoints; no worker crash, lost native outcome, production job lease or service replacement is simulated.
Queue wait is this local diagnostic admission delay; no Supabase/n8n queueHTTP or API/browser responsiveness measurement.
One retry is an explicit closed test injection before native work; native corrupt/unsupported inputs fail independently without retry.
Local byte resume is a harness file append/checksum boundary, not AT-055 Storage/TUS upload acceptance.
Provider usage/cost, independent endurance and production capacity remain unmeasured; no hosting/deployment performed.
